# `hk validate`

- **Usage:** `hk validate [--json] [--deny-warnings]`
- **Effect:** read-only

Validate the config file

Errors for configs hk cannot run. Also prints warnings for settings that load but probably do not do what was meant: unknown properties (which release builds silently drop), `depends` that never orders anything, steps without a command, and globs that cannot match.

## Flags

- **`--json`** — Print the result as a JSON document on stdout
- **`--deny-warnings`** — Exit with a non-zero status when the config has warnings
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Evaluate the selected configuration without running its linter commands.

```sh
hk validate
HK_FILE=./hk.local.pkl hk validate
```
